reasoning: Cross-cutting feature touching multiple systems (camera, tools, animation, editing) across 6-8 files. Single service with no external integrations or infrastructure changes. Standard React/browser patterns with medium integration complexity.

scope.notes: Keyboard shortcuts affect multiple systems: camera presets, tool selection, undo/redo, save, animation controls, plus new help overlay UI

integrations.notes: Uses standard browser keyboard event APIs with React hooks. No external libraries needed.

infrastructure.notes: Frontend-only feature with no infrastructure impact

knowledge.notes: React hooks and Zustand patterns exist in codebase. Standard keyboard event handling with preventDefault() for browser conflict management.

concerns: Input field conflicts - shortcuts must not trigger when typing in text fields
Browser shortcut conflicts - Ctrl+S, Ctrl+Z may require preventDefault()
Cross-platform keyboard differences (Ctrl vs Cmd on Mac)
Event listener cleanup to prevent memory leaks
Integration with multiple existing systems (camera, tools, animation)
Accessibility - shortcuts should supplement, not replace mouse navigation
risk.notes: Main risks are around event handling edge cases and ensuring smooth integration with existing camera preset, tool selection, and animation systems

validation_recommendations.reasoning: Multiple integration points with existing systems require unit tests for keyboard event handler logic and integration tests to verify shortcuts correctly trigger camera changes, tool selection, undo/redo, save, and animation controls. No security implications.
